# RF2 0.31 development candidate

Apple Silicon macOS only. This is separate from the stable release.

The zip contains the native compiler, runtime/MCP service, text-search application, compiler source, worked examples, MIT licence and per-file SHA manifest. The runtime retains its0.17 contract with nine bounded tools. No embedded AI model or new raw-system MCP execution is included.

The binaries are locally ad-hoc signed, not Apple notarized. Use normal OS security review; this package does not automate bypassing warnings. Native operations need no Node/npm/Python runtime. Developer test and packaging controllers remain separate tools.

See [qualification and limits](../../docs/FOUNDATION-0.31.md), the manifest, zip SHA and fresh-extraction receipt. Checks were on the same Mac; this is not second-host qualification, institutional approval or a security certificate.
